slides.headline: Don't renovate before you sell
slides.say: Selling in George? Don't renovate before you sell. Do this instead.

slides.headline: A new kitchen sells it
slides.body: Many buyers want to choose their own finishes.
slides.say: Big renovations rarely pay back rand for rand. And many buyers want to choose their own finishes anyway.

slides.headline: Fix the small things
slides.body: Leaky taps, loose handles, sticking doors.
slides.say: Instead, fix the small things. Leaky taps, loose handles, sticking doors.

slides.headline: Clean, declutter, paint
slides.body: Fresh, neutral rooms look better in photos.
slides.say: Then clean, declutter and touch up the paint. Fresh, neutral rooms look better in photos.
